title: Parsed welcome offer
description: One tracked card's welcome offer as numbers, built by scripts/parse_offers.py from the offer text read on the issuer's page. Feeds card.schema.json's welcomeBonus and typicalMinSpend. Draft.

hasWelcomeOffer.description: false = the site owner confirmed the card has no welcome offer; null = unknown (its page was never read).

needsReview.description: True when the parser was unsure (struck-through pair, missing spend or window, first part only, unparsed).

sourceText.description: The offer sentence as read from the issuer's page.

kind.description: match = a first-year match of earnings with no fixed amount.

points.description: Points or miles in the card's own currency; authorized-user bonuses and PQP excluded.

cashBack.description: Cash, gift cards and general statement credits at face value; credits tied to specific spending excluded.

freeNightAwards.description: Counted, not valued; the catalog assigns their value.

additionalTiers.description: Extra bonuses for more spending. The engine includes them when the household's spending capacity meets the first threshold.

ceiling.description: "As high as" / "up to": a maximum, not what everyone gets.

currency.description: Set when the offer is paid in a specific points currency (id from valuations/currencies).

displayedAsCash.description: The dollar figure the issuer advertises when the bonus is actually paid as points.

reviewedByOwner.description: The site owner checked this row.

stale.description: Read before the issuer was paused; may be out of date.
